summary: Four Issue #68 review defects were fixed and verified, but required desktop/mobile browser acceptance remains environment-blocked.

findings.description: Required live Electron browser verification at desktop and 375px mobile widths is still incomplete because both Electron and the repository-prepared Chrome exit before exposing CDP in this managed environment.

Symlink validation ran only after complete-home detection, so an empty symlinked home or a symlinked required file in a partial home could fall through to the normal installer path instead of failing closed.
Desktop adoption wrote the ownership metadata successfully but then propagated a failed Docker status refresh, causing the launcher to report the completed adoption as a failure.
Opening live logs unnecessarily fetched runtime status first, making recovery logs inaccessible whenever Docker or guarded status inspection was unavailable.
Canceling the new adoption confirmation attempted to focus the disabled Stop control, leaving keyboard focus in the hidden confirmation panel instead of returning it to the action trigger.
